description: Default capability set for the main window. The fs:allow-* entries grant the commands, not a path scope: no standing scope is handed to the webview, so the frontend can only read and write paths the user picked in a dialog (the dialog plugin adds the picked path to the fs scope for that session). Everything else goes through the Rust commands. The android-fs grants below cover only the app's private directories ($APPDATA, $APPCACHE, $TEMP). User-visible documents are read from and written to the Storage Access Framework (content:// URIs the user picked), which needs no standing path grant: no persistent access to shared storage (public Documents/Downloads or other apps' files) exists.
